title: Revocation list publication
acceptance: List is republished with a new published_at at least every RL_INTERVAL even when unchanged, scheduled by a Durable Object alarm
Version increases whenever contents change; entries expire after the revoked attestation's valid_to
Served from R2 behind the cache
findings: Correction: Cron Triggers run no more often than once a minute, so they can miss a strict 60 s interval; use Durable Object alarms.
